coordinateSystem: Original DAMIT co-rotating Cartesian frame, +Z spin pole and +X reference meridian; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: DAMIT model 4215, version 2019-05-07: ecliptic J2000 pole (153.73, 12.69) degrees and sidereal period 24.4984 h. Equatorial conversion uses obliquity 23.439291111 degrees. Absolute phase is arbitrary. Pole and period refined by Dutra et al. (2025), Tables 5–6, for this same source model.
